title: The length of a diagonal
description:
Write `hypot_round(a, b)`: it returns √(a² + b²) rounded to the nearest whole number. The arguments are integers in `rdi` and `rsi`; do the arithmetic in xmm registers and convert the result with `cvtsd2si`.

| Call | Result |
|---|---|
| `hypot_round(3, 4)` | 5 |
| `hypot_round(2, 3)` | 4 (√13 = 3.61) |
| `hypot_round(-6, 8)` | 10 |

starter.solution.asm:
hypot_round:
        mov     rax, rdi
        add     rax, rsi
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
hypot_round:
        cvtsi2sd xmm0, rdi
        mulsd   xmm0, xmm0              ; a * a
        cvtsi2sd xmm1, rsi
        mulsd   xmm1, xmm1              ; b * b
        addsd   xmm0, xmm1
        sqrtsd  xmm0, xmm0
        cvtsd2si rax, xmm0              ; round to the nearest
        ret

hints: `cvtsi2sd xmm0, rdi` turns the integer into a double. `mulsd xmm0, xmm0` squares it in place.
`cvtsd2si` rounds to the nearest whole number; `cvttsd2si` would cut the fraction off and give 3 for √13.
unitTests:
test "right triangles"
    hypot_round(3, 4) == 5
    hypot_round(5, 12) == 13
    hypot_round(-6, 8) == 10
test "rounded"
    hypot_round(2, 3) == 4
    hypot_round(1, 1) == 1
    hypot_round(0, 0) == 0
    hypot_round(1000000, 1) == 1000000
